META_DESCRIPTION: Track restaurants, takeout, coffee, and delivery. FincWin's Dining envelope shows the true cost of eating out.
HERO_H1:
Eating out is one of life's
great pleasures. Until you see the total.
HERO_SUB: Restaurants, takeout, coffee shops, food delivery — dining out adds up faster than any other discretionary category. FincWin's Dining envelope makes every meal visible, not just memorable.
PAIN_H2:
Dining out is the budget
category most people underestimate twice.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: The daily coffee that's not "real spending"
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: $6.50 latte every weekday. That's $32.50/week, $130/month, $1,560/year. You never counted it as a food expense because it never felt like one — it was just coffee.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: Delivery fees that double the cost of convenience
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: That $14 pad thai you ordered actually cost $14 + $4 delivery + $3 service fee + $3 tip = $24. You ordered three times this week. Your $42 in food was actually $72.
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: $14 lunch every weekday is $280–$300/month. That's $3,360 per year on lunches alone. With a dining envelope, you know by day 12 whether you're on pace to blow past it.
FEATURES_H2:
The Dining envelope:
enjoy every meal, know every dollar.
CARD_1_P: Log a dining expense in under 10 seconds. Name, amount, done. At the end of the week you have a real picture of what eating out cost you — not a vague estimate.
CARD_2_P: Your daily coffee habit is a real budget line. Log it under Dining and see the true weekly, monthly, and annual total. Then decide — with full information — whether it's worth it.
CARD_3_P: See your dining spend charted month by month. The trend line reveals whether eating out is creeping up — and gives you the data to make an informed decision about it.
